title: K1 closed loop on the 45F + K1-vs-full-scan sweep
label: TEST ONLY. Pre-registration committed before any v0.1.21 measurement. No Fmax, no sweep verdict, and no trimmed cell count in this file. Power is needs real board.

locked_decisions.name: v0.1.21
locked_decisions.v0_2: reserved for the first product-facing page

fit.goal: places and routes on LFE5U-45F for all five seeds, TRELLIS_COMB <= 43848, bit-exact decoder codes and K1 decision records versus the golden model

baseline_from_v0120.note: Committed v0.1.20 pack-log demand and placed constituent LUT counts. Not a v0.1.21 measurement.

fit.allowed_trims: W4 encoder and/or W4 decoder datapath only. K1 RTL (scp4d_ede, scp4d_fsd) stays unchanged except where the loop integration requires it. Temporal-only stays the default.
fit.bit_exact_rule: A trim keeps the v0.1.19 bit-exact regression passing for the trimmed modules, or it ships as a new named variant (tenc_q_w4l8_lite / tdec_s_w4_lite) with its own golden vectors. The v0.1.19 designs stay untouched.
fit.stop_rule: If the loop cannot place on the 45F without breaking bit-exactness, stop and report the best demand. Do not invent a fit.

sweep.metric: decisions/s per LUT = (evals / cycles) * five-seed 45F median Fmax_MHz * 1e6 / TRELLIS_COMB of the median-Fmax seed
sweep.evals: threshold compares (code > threshold), not emitted decision-change records
sweep.addr_w_fallback: If an ADDR_W does not place on the 45F, drop it and keep the largest ADDR_W that does place. Do not invent an Fmax for a width that did not route.
sweep.temporal_stream: For each ADDR_W the five 45F seeds are placed once. Fmax and TRELLIS_COMB are that placement. Churn does not get its own place-and-route: evals and cycles come from Icarus on a temporal-only stream at that ADDR_W, and the same Fmax and LUT are reused.
sweep.stream_width: D is the largest power-of-two depth that fits in ADDR_W and in the env T64 spatial size (D = 2048) . ADDR_W 8 uses D = 256. ADDR_W 10 uses D = 1024. ADDR_W 12 uses D = 2048. T = 64. Predictor last. Relations off. Churn picks max(1, round(fraction * D)) elements per frame.
sweep.win: K1 wins a cell (ADDR_W, churn) when its decisions/s per LUT is >= 1.0 times fsd, using the five-seed median Fmax and the median-Fmax seed's TRELLIS_COMB.

verdict.PASS: K1 wins at least one pre-registered cell, and the win is not only the MIXED case.
verdict.MIXED: K1 wins only at the largest ADDR_W that was placed, and every winning cell at that width has ratio < 1.1.

sweep.serial: The sweep place-and-route does not run at the same time as the loop fit place-and-route.
